verdict.rationale: Independent reviews (TechPowerUp) confirm 'good gaming performance' and HN threads discuss benchmark score gains, providing real independent corroboration, but the same sources note the gen-over-gen performance increase is 'smaller than expected' and that price-to-performance ratio is weak relative to older cards. No specific 4K high-refresh FPS numbers or head-to-head DLSS-off benchmarks are included. Missing for 10: concrete independent 4K high-refresh benchmark figures across multiple AAA titles, and resolution of the noted smaller-than-expected performance gains.
